title: AirLLM Fused Chunked Linear Cross-Entropy Without [N, vocab] Logit Materialization
author: ontology-spider-and-rea-learning-wave

edges.description: lyogavin/airllm chunked_ce.py at af3c212c52ebecad95f0d25eb2595e82988d0cdd; verified by REA pyc_function extraction (_compute_device, _ChunkedCE, chunked_linear_cross_entropy)
Enables under-6GB fine-tuning alongside layer-wise frozen weight streaming

claims.assertion: _ChunkedCE sweeps lm_head weight slices [start:end] in chunks of chunk_size=4096 (even from CPU host weight tensors) accumulating float32 log-sum-exp partition constants via torch.logaddexp and target logits without allocating the full [N, vocab] logits matrix, then recomputes chunks in backward().

distilled_learning: Avoid OOM spikes from multi-hundred-thousand-token vocabularies by streaming lm_head projections in bounded chunks (4096 rows) with running float32 logaddexp normalization constants and chunked gradient recomputation.
